title: onoc-fcnn-allocation: simulator for collective-aware core allocation on a ring optical network-on-chip
description: Simulator, independent reference implementations, experiment drivers, profiler traces and result data for the paper Collective-Aware Core Allocation for Fully Connected Neural Network Training on a Ring Optical Network-on-Chip. It regenerates every table, figure and quoted number of the paper from the included result files, and includes the physically constrained, Hummingbird-style clustered network in which every optical transmission stays within an 8 dB power split.
